semiconductor_relevance: Medium — SAM Technologies provides specialized testing equipment crucial for semiconductor R&D and quality control.
summary: SAM Technologies, under the brand STECH, offers advanced testing apparatus and system solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their product range includes Transformer Testers, Power Meters, and Environmental Test Chambers, serving R&D, Quality Control, and Production processes.

regional_presence.India: SAM Technologies has facilities in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, and Delhi, serving a diverse clientele across the country.
